## Codex Pointer 0.6.0 — English / 中文

[Website / 双语主页](https://youisan.github.io/codex-pointer/) · [English documentation](https://github.com/youisan/codex-pointer#readme) · [中文说明](https://github.com/youisan/codex-pointer/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)

### What's new

- The native circle, task panel, target preview, menus, chat picker, quick tasks and local messages now support English and Simplified Chinese.
- The companion follows Codex's desktop language setting. Changes refresh the interface in place without replacing your draft, target, linked chat or screenshot choice. Automatic language selection uses the Windows preferred UI language; other languages use English.
- The sidebar launcher follows the host's locale, including language changes while it is open.
- English and Chinese READMEs now show matching real light/dark interface screenshots. Both language versions and homepage previews are included in the complete ZIP.

### 中文

- 浮动按钮、任务面板、目标预览、菜单、对话选择器、快捷任务与提示信息均支持中英文。
- 跟随 Codex 设置语言，运行中切换会保留草稿、目标、绑定对话与截图选项。自动检测时使用 Windows 首选界面语言；其他语言回退英文。
- 侧边栏启动页跟随客户端语言。两份 README 分别展示对应语言的真实浅色、深色界面，完整 ZIP 包含配图。

### Install / 安装

Download **codex-pointer-0.6.0-windows-x64.zip**, extract the complete folder, and run in its `codex-pointer` directory:

```powershell
codex plugin marketplace add .
codex plugin add codex-pointer@codex-pointer-local
```

Quit the old circle, reload plugins or restart Codex, then open **Explore → Codex Pointer → Show button**. Requires Windows 10/11 x64 and a signed-in Codex desktop client.

升级前请右键退出旧圆圈，重载插件或重启 Codex，再从插件入口显示按钮。

This is an unsigned community preview, not an OpenAI product. Verify downloads against **SHA256SUMS.txt**. Screenshots require opt-in; tasks are sent only through explicit user actions. Licenses and third-party notices are included in the ZIP.
